body:
🌌 Through the Multiverse

Through the Multiverse is a content + adventure mod that introduces new weapons, ores, currencies, and story-driven mechanics to Minecraft.
It’s designed for players who want progression, lore, and unique gameplay systems beyond vanilla.

✨ Features

🗡️ The Katana
A powerful weapon that can be upgraded with rare materials:

Sunlight Ingot – forged from pure light.

Dying Star Metal – still under development.

Happy Coins – a unique currency used across the multiverse.

⚒️ New Materials & Ores

Sun Ore – a glowing ore found deep in the overworld.

Light Ore – a rare ore infused with pure radiance.

Sun Ingot – smelted from Sun Ore.

Light Ingot – smelted from Light Ore.

🔱 Spear of Light


🎭 Interactive Dialog & Lore (Under Development)

NPCs and systems will react differently depending on what items or currency you hold.

Planned story progression includes the journey of Adam, who was teleported into another world and must find a way home.

🎯 Why Play Through the Multiverse?

If you enjoy mods with:
✔️ Progression-based weapon upgrades
✔️ New ores and ingots
✔️ Custom currencies
✔️ Powerful upcoming weapons
✔️ Interactive lore & story systems (coming soon)

…then Through the Multiverse is for you.
